note: yaw_offset_deg 87.5 is the angle the maps were built with (set 2026-09-02 from the rear posts). MEASURED 2026-10-07 as ~90.5: the lidar frame sits ~3 deg clockwise of the travel axis (20 drives' lidar truth crabbed +3.27 deg [2.65, 3.98] left of its own x while driving straight, scratch/_from_worktrees/vio-review/crab.py; a 4 m straight run +2.97 [1.45, 5.19] with the heading turning only 0.43 deg, scratch/lidar_yaw/crab_one.py drive 0381, and +0.51 once recorded at 90.5, drive 0382; the wall ahead with the bumper pressed to it +2.7..3.2 over four scans, scratch/lidar_yaw/wall.py; the rear edge read +1.5, so the body's rear is ~1.5 deg off square to the axle). NOT applied live: RTAB-Map's map stores every node's scan under the angle it was built with, so a changed angle makes the lidar and the camera disagree by 3 deg on every match and the localisation is rejected (tried 17:55-18:30Z on 2026-10-07; the map slipped on the bookshelf drive). Apply 90.5 together with a map rebuild or a reprocessed database; until then the odometry scoring corrects the lidar truth's heading by +3.0 deg offline (eight drives of 2026-10-07 read +0.1 deg [-1.2, +0.5] corrected). x_m/y_m/z_m and roll_deg/yaw_offset_deg are the base_link -> laser mount (the LD19 hangs upside down): published by the board's launch and by the laptop's camera node from this one file. z_m 0.383 m was measured with a tape on 2026-09-12, floor to the middle of the sensor's window; the 0.20 m that stood here before it was never measured. The pictures agree: at 0.383 the beams and the vertical walls read the same depth-network scale (3 % apart, 18 % at 0.20) and the fused band's median distance to the lidar goes 12.9 -> 3.8 cm (scratch/lidar_height_check.py, scratch/lidar_height_fix_report.py). Nothing else may repeat this number: every threshold that depends on the lidar's plane reads the mount (pepin.mounts.load_lidar_mount).offline. x_m/y_m/z_m and roll_deg/yaw_offset_deg are the base_link -> laser mount (the LD19 hangs upside down): published by the board's launch and by the laptop's camera node from this one file. z_m 0.383 m was measured with a tape on 2026-09-12, floor to the middle of the sensor's window; the 0.20 m that stood here before it was never measured.
